newsitem.title: UK: Norway's Troll crude to load 7.4 mln bls in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Norway's Troll crude to load 7.4 mln bls in Sept.

text.p: Norway's Troll oilfield is scheduled to load 7.4 million barrels of crude oil in September, compared to 5.15 million in August, traders said on Thursday.
The September programme consists of three cargoes of one million barrels, four of 600,000 barrels and five of 400,000 barrels, they said.
Volumes are expected to average 246,000 barrels per day (bpd) in September, recovering strongly from August's 166,000 bpd which was depressed by a planned six-day maintenance shutdown.
Troll loaded 7.4 million barrels in July.
